equity.level_reason: The infection rate among MSM (259 per 100,000) is set beside the rate among all other groups (16) with no ratio or disparity framing; MSM are treated as a risk group. Race, education, income and insurance only describe respondents.

level_alternative.reason: MSM status mainly defines the outbreak population as a transmission risk group, so the rate contrast could be read as population definition plus descriptors.
